title: LawnMaster Electric Pressure Washer

comparisons.notes: LawnMaster Corded Electric Pressure Washer LT506-2000A, same 2300 max PSI / 1.4 GPM, 20-ft hose, 35-ft cord, 22.6 lb, same accessory kit; listed at $139.99 with no sold-out marker.

writeup: Woot has the LawnMaster corded electric pressure washer new for $64.99, while LawnMaster's own Cleva store sells the same unit for $139.99. It's rated up to 2300 max PSI at 1.4 GPM, with a 20-ft hose, 35-ft power cord, turbo lance, 20-oz foam bottle, brush and wheel hub brush included. Stock is very low with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Checker matched ASIN B0FR8WPF4Z to LawnMaster LT506.01, same unit as LT506-2000A.
